decisions.reason: Pre-reflow moisture control for the AXP2101 does not change the battery NTC monitoring interface or thermal-protection behavior.
Baking the AXP2101 before reflow does not change the panel button, PWRON connection, or power-control behavior.
The manufacturing precaution for the AXP2101 does not change the MT3608 boost rail, its GPIO enable control, or its powered loads.
The AXP2101 baking decision does not alter copper-pour continuity, current capacity, or stitching-via requirements.
Pre-reflow moisture control affects assembly reliability but does not change the required AXP2101 battery and system power-path behavior.
The baking requirement does not resolve or change VBACKUP access, VRTC handling, or the existing auxiliary-pin ambiguity.
The AXP2101 assembly precaution does not change the requirement to expose PWROK through a test pad or via.
Baking the AXP2101 before reflow does not change its required battery-protection functions, cutoff values, or associated protection circuitry.
The AXP2101 moisture-control decision is unrelated to ESP32 supply-decoupling components and placement.
The manufacturing handling of the AXP2101 does not change the charge-status LED interface, connector, resistor, or display method.
Although damaged AXP2101 samples may explain abnormal operation, the baking decision does not change the required DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or regulation behavior.
The AXP2101 pre-reflow baking requirement does not change the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, pin functions, or unresolved pin order.
